headline: US Senate Passes Bipartisan Permitting Reform Bill for Energy Projects
summary: The US Senate approved bipartisan legislation designed to accelerate regulatory reviews and permitting processes for major energy and infrastructure construction projects.
why: Permitting timelines have historically delayed power generation, interstate transmission lines, and energy infrastructure across the United States.

impacts.name: US Energy Infrastructure
impacts.why: Faster approvals reduce project lead times and capital expenditure uncertainty for developers.
